newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Nam Fatt to restructure, list unit.
newsitem.headline: Nam Fatt to restructure, list unit.

text.p: Infrastructure construction concern Nam Fatt Corp Bhd said it is planning to restructure and list the stock of 90-percent owned unit Nam Fatt Industries Bhd.

In a statement, Nam Fatt Corp said Nam Fatt Industries, involved in manufacturing, would acquire all the shares of Vickers Hoskins (M) Sdn Bhd and Nam Fatt Marketing Sdn Bhd from Nam Fatt Corp for a total of 32.5 million ringgit to be satisfied by an issue of stock in Nam Fatt Industries.
After completion of the proposed acquisitions, Nam Fatt Industries proposes to conduct a rights issue of 23.24 million shares at 1.10 ringgit a share on a nine-for-10 basis.
In the proposed public stock issue, Nam Fatt Industries proposes to make an issue of 941,000 shares at 2.15 ringgit a share and also plans to sell 17.76 million shares at 2.15 ringgit a piece.
The company is seeking a listing for its enlarged issued and paid-up share capital comprising 49.99 million shares on the Second Board of the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange.
Nam Fatt Corp said the listing of its unit will enable it to tap external sources of funds for the future expansion of the group.
